Palette: deep slate blue and warm restrained copper accent, solid fills.
Composition: centered horizontal or gently stacked complete logo with actual transparent padding; mark separable and legible at 32px.
Constraints: no imagery of county crest/flag, no steering wheel, no generic automobile outline, no paper/mockup/background box, no light effects; exact lettering must be legible, no watermark. Independent proposal, not dealership adoption.
